metadata.capability_cutoff: Current-generation roster only. Historical generations dropped in merge: Claude Opus 5/4.6, Sonnet 4.5, Gemini 3.5 Pro/Flash, GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra, Grok 4.6, Qwen 2.5 Coder 32B.
notes: One record per model; per-effort AA v5 scores, blended cost-per-task and Pareto flags live in effort_variants[].
Single-source records (badge pack) carry null telemetry/pricing until added to sync/update_models.ps1 trackedCatalog.
frontier_delta_pct for single-source records is an AA-index-only proxy vs the 57.6 Opus 5.5 ceiling.

DATA CONFLICT WARNING: the badge pack's AA Index v5 per-effort scores diverge from the telemetry catalog's headline intelligence_index for most non-Opus models (different AA index vintages/normalizations). Both are preserved: scores.intelligence_index (OpenRouter/Models.dev telemetry catalog) vs effort_variants[].aa_score (badge pack AA v5 extraction). Reconcile before treating either as canonical.
